{{Top|canon=Mk IV Firestorm}}
The '''Firestorm''' was a type of [[fire grenade]] produced by [[Wynz-Tek/Legends|Wynz-Tek]]. During the [[battle for the Black Hole]], the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] criminal [[Kovic]] used a variety of Wynz-Tek grenades, including Firestorms, in battle.
